name: GitHub Tricks
description: Every GitHub feature, URL trick, keyboard shortcut, search qualifier, Actions pattern and third-party tool worth knowing, each one checked against the source. Covers URL parameters, the one-word hostname swaps that turn a repository into an editor, a prompt, a diagram or an MCP server, the full search syntax with its undocumented index limits, Actions traps that fail silently, security and supply-chain defaults, and profile README mechanics. Tips that no longer work are listed as dead rather than repeated.
